Vendored third-party assets, used as static files with no build step:

- `inter/` — Inter typeface (weights 400/500/600/700, Latin subset),
  from the `@fontsource/inter` npm package. Licensed under the
  SIL Open Font License 1.1.
- `phosphor/` — Phosphor Icons (regular + fill weights), from the
  `@phosphor-icons/web` npm package. Licensed under the MIT License.
